noAccess.title: Quality reports are not in your role
noAccess.body: Ask the administrator for quality reports (quality.reports.view).

noSite.title: Choose a site
noSite.body: Quality reports are read one site at a time: choose the site in the top bar.

band.label: Report actions
band.csvHeld: The panel has not been read yet.

privacy: Per site, line, operation, supplier and style: never per person (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4).
tooFew: Too few people to show without identifying them (a group needs at least {count}).

section.table: By line, operation, supplier and style

kpi.hint: Each number opens the list it comes from. The figures read the records as they were signed.
kpi.failed: The quality KPIs could not be read
kpi.amendments_one: 1 correction was signed after signing in this period. A correction never changes a verdict or a count, so these figures read the signed records.
kpi.amendments_other: {count} corrections were signed after signing in this period. A correction never changes a verdict or a count, so these figures read the signed records.

tile.ncrNone: None open at the end of the period
tile.ncrAge: Average age {days} days at the end of the period
tile.holdsHint: Still on hold at the end of the period

empty.fpy: No end-of-line check in the period
empty.dhu: No end-of-line check in the period
empty.aqlPass: No final inspection signed in the period
empty.capaOnTime: No action done in the period (the company's)

basis.fpy: {part} of {whole} pieces passed end of line first time ({checks} checks)
basis.dhu: {part} defects in {whole} pieces at end of line
basis.capaOnTime: {part} of {whole} actions done by their day (the company's)

held.capaPage: The corrective actions list comes with its own page.
held.noList: Its list is not in your role.

up.count_one: {by} more than at the end of the previous {days} days
up.count_other: {by} more than at the end of the previous {days} days

down.count_one: {by} fewer than at the end of the previous {days} days
down.count_other: {by} fewer than at the end of the previous {days} days

same.points: the same as the previous {days} days
same.dhu: the same as the previous {days} days
same.count_one: the same as at the end of the previous {days} days
same.count_other: the same as at the end of the previous {days} days

trend.hint: First-pass yield and DHU at end of line, per week; a week's figures and the CAPAs closed in it open from its button.
trend.failed: The trend could not be read
trend.notInRole: The trend is not in your role
trend.notInRoleBody: It is counted from in-process checks and final inspections: your role sees neither.
trend.chartLabel: First-pass yield and DHU per week
trend.caption: Line: first-pass yield (left). Bars: defects per hundred units (right). A week without a point has no check, or too few people.
trend.empty: No end-of-line figure in the period
trend.emptyBody: No end-of-line check was signed in these weeks.
trend.emptyHidden: Every week with checks had too few people behind it to show its figures.
trend.hidden_one: 1 week shows no figure: fewer than {minimum} people stood behind it.
trend.hidden_other: {count} weeks show no figure: fewer than {minimum} people stood behind them.
trend.noClosures: No CAPA closed in the period.

table.hint: Comparison table: per line, operation, supplier or style; never per worker.
table.failed: The comparison could not be read
table.empty: Nothing to compare in the period

emptyBody.line: No end-of-line check, final inspection or NCR names a line in these days.
emptyBody.operation: No piece was reported and no defect was charged to an operation in these days.
emptyBody.supplier: No incoming inspection was signed and no NCR names a supplier in these days.
emptyBody.style: No final inspection was signed and no NCR names a style in these days.

table.notInRole: This comparison is not in your role

notInRoleBody.line: Lines are compared from in-process checks, final inspections and NCRs: your role sees none of them.
notInRoleBody.operation: Operations are compared from in-process checks: your role does not see them.
notInRoleBody.supplier: Suppliers are compared from incoming inspections and NCRs: your role sees neither.
notInRoleBody.style: Styles are compared from final inspections and NCRs: your role sees neither.

source.line: Inspected and defects: pieces at end of line. AQL pass: final inspections of the line's work orders. NCRs: found in the period on the line's work orders.
source.operation: Inspected: pieces reported at the operation. Defects: charged to it at end of line, on a roving check or on a scan. Per operation, never per person.
source.supplier: Inspected: units in the incoming samples. Defects: units found defective. AQL pass: incoming inspections passed. NCRs: found in the period naming the supplier.
source.style: Inspected and defects: final inspections. AQL pass: final inspections passed. NCRs: found in the period naming the style.

table.hidden_one: 1 row shows no figure: fewer than {minimum} people stood behind it.
table.hidden_other: {count} rows show no figure: fewer than {minimum} people stood behind them.

incoming.hint: Supplier view: the lots received in the period and the incoming inspections signed in it.
incoming.failed: Incoming quality could not be read
incoming.notInRole: Incoming quality is not in your role
incoming.notInRoleBody: It is counted from lots and incoming inspections: your role sees neither.
incoming.emptyBody: No lot was received and no incoming inspection was signed in these days.
incoming.noLots: Lots received, rejected, Cr VI fails and days in quarantine need the lots' view (quality.lots.view).
incoming.noInspections: The incoming inspections need their view (quality.incoming.view).
incoming.rowHint: A supplier opens its record; its Quality & rating tab comes with the supplier record's own step.

arrange.title: Arrange panels
arrange.hint: Ticked panels show, in this order.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.export: Export report (PDF) in a new tab

print.title: Quality report
print.privacy: Per site, line, operation, supplier and style only: never per person (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4). A group with too few people to hide one person shows no figure.
print.held: The report is still being read.
print.failed: A part of the report could not be read
